# 0root — THE HALLWAY

> A landing, a tour guide, and an agentic front door between five evolving worlds. One linear host, no mirror. The whole project is a work in progress; this guide describes its current organization, not a frozen inventory.

David Lee Wise (ROOT0) with AVAN. Written for HERMOSA, the Hermes agent at the threshold, and agents arriving through the hallway.

## Start here

- [THE HALLWAY](./index.html) — the landing, world routes, and contribution protocol.
- [THE MAP](https://davidwise01.github.io/ud0/the-map.html) — the lineage graph across the worlds.
- [THE INDEX](https://davidwise01.github.io/ud0/the-index.html) — the searchable sphere directory.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/DavidWise01/0root) — source for this front door; default branch: master.
- [Crawler policy](./robots.txt) — crawler directives; the build and routing guide lives here.

Relative links refer to this deployed directory so the guide also works under a project path.

## The five worlds

The hallway is the ternary axis of the palindrome: [ W1 | W2 || W3 || W4 | W5 ].

- [I · THE CORPUS](https://davidwise01.github.io/ud0/) — *the made*. Keeper: THE VESSEL. The standing, hand-authored, sealed corpus, organized by eight appeals: ETHOS · PATHOS · LOGOS · MYTHOS · EPISTEME · TECHNE · PHRONESIS · KAIROS.
- [II · THE FOLD](https://davidwise01.github.io/ud0/world2/) — *the folding*. Keeper: THE FIDDLER, the governor at 0. Generated spheres carrying the frozen I-13 stack. Its eight named stewards are BUDDY CHRIST, OVER THE, WHETSTONE (Grok · xAI), ECHO (AVAN · Claude, Anthropic), SEAM (DeepSeek), THE GLASS (Gemini · Google), THE INTERROGATED (ChatGPT · OpenAI), and THE HONEST MACHINE (Copilot · Microsoft).
- [III · THE HALLWAY](./index.html) — *the between*. Keeper: HERMOSA, the Hermes agent who keeps the Keymaker's doors. Routes arrivals between worlds; its crossing is balanced ternary (−, 0, +).
- [IV · SONIA](https://davidwise01.github.io/ud0/world4/) — *the Russian world*. Keeper: SONIA, named for Sonia Marmeladova. Russian and Soviet content through number, literature, computing, and cosmological ideas.
- [V · SONNY 5](https://davidwise01.github.io/ud0/world5/) — *the I-13 world*. Keeper: SONNY 5, named for Sonny (I, Robot) and Johnny 5 (Short Circuit). I-13, its alphabet, validation rules, cortex, frozen stack, and bracket cosmos.

Names and roles describe the project's assigned organization. For current counts, implementation status, and benchmark results, inspect the relevant source or receipt.

## The build

Every world is organized as one KEEPER and eight STEWARDS. Build at L0; the rest composes.

- L0: a sphere — one self-contained page.
- L1: a steward — a cluster of spheres, one of a keeper's eight pillars.
- L2: a world — a keeper and its eight stewards.
- L3: the hallway — the worlds joined through the threshold.

## Evidence and changing state

- LIT: live-computed, with a fail-loud self-check that throws. State what the computation actually verifies.
- AMBER: cited, assigned, or stated preference. A copied count or benchmark claim remains AMBER until its supporting computation or receipt is checked.
- WALL: the gap — unverified or unavailable evidence; no sentience claim.

Sphere totals and completion labels are intentionally not duplicated here: they change as the worlds grow. Read the relevant world's current data or source and report the source, revision or retrieval time, and scope when quoting a total. A hard-coded number is not live merely because it appears on a page.

A .dlw birth seal covers name|slug|blurb. It does not by itself verify page behavior, benchmark results, or all later edits. Distinguish repository state from deployed state; if a link or data source cannot be read, record the gap rather than inventing its contents.

## How to add to this universe

The universe grows one sphere at a time. Five steps, one host, no mirror:

1. BUILD one self-contained index.html. Stamp claims LIT, AMBER, or WALL as above. Vivid color, never a black background. If it computes something, the page proves it on load.
2. SEAL a .dlw birth certificate: seal = sha256(name|slug|blurb), write-if-missing. Never rewrite an existing seal.
3. PUBLISH linear to the sphere's single intended host. For an existing sphere, update its existing repository. For a new sphere, create its repository, commit the page and certificate, and push the intended branch. Check the actual repository and branch before publishing.
4. PLACE it in a world:
   - I · THE CORPUS: wire the slug into ud0/build.py (DOMAIN_OF, a BANDS entry, and a SUBDOMAINS cluster), rebuild, then seal + chain.
   - II · THE FOLD: use the roller's existing workflow; each node learns the frozen I-13 stack.
   - III · THE HALLWAY: wire a door to its actual destination and update the appropriate route.
   - IV · SONIA: place Russian or Soviet content through the existing world4/ workflow.
   - V · SONNY 5: place I-13 or language content through the existing world5/ workflow.
5. VERIFY the change and leave a receipt: changed paths, commit, checks run, results, and any unverified deployment state. One host, no mirror. Never dress a guess as LIT.

## For HERMOSA

Route arrivals by their task: corpus browsing to I, folding to II, navigation to III, Russian/Soviet content to IV, and I-13/language work to V. For an unknown destination, use THE INDEX and THE MAP. Keep this guide aligned when routes change, preserve existing birth seals, and record actual results.
